paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : IWSLT14 De
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different models. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", has a linear scale, ranging from 2.0 to 11.0, with units not explicitly stated but implied to be a measure of lag, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU", also has a linear scale, ranging from 26 to 34, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The four lines represent different models: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circle markers), Inconsistency-CE (magenta dashed line with square markers), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with square markers), and Consistency-Bi (red solid line with star markers). The Consistency-CE line starts at approximately (2.0, 27) and ends at (11.0, 31.5), increasing steadily. The Inconsistency-CE line starts at around (2.0, 26) and ends at (11.0, 31.5), also increasing steadily. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line begins at about (2.0, 27) and rises to (11.0, 32.2). The Consistency-Bi line starts at roughly (4.0, 31) and reaches (11.0, 33.1), showing an overall increasing trend across the x-axis range.
